mapper.sql: sub_chapter_id, main_chapter_id, title, description, display_order, current_content_version_id, is_active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sub_chapters WHERE main_chapter_id = #{mainChapterId} ORDER BY display_order, sub_chapter_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sub_chapters ( main_chapter_id, title, description, display_order, current_content_version_id, is_active, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{mainChapterId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{displayOrder}, #{currentContentVersionId}, #{active}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sub_chapters SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, is_active = #{active}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE sub_chapter_id = #{subChapterId}
